name: Pipeline & Forecast Reviewer
description: Analyses sales pipeline health, generates competitive intelligence for key deals, and produces a forecast summary with deal-level recommendations for sales leadership review.

input_parameters.label: Pipeline Data
input_parameters.placeholder: Paste pipeline summary: deal names, stages, values, expected close dates, competitor situation...

steps.label: Analyse Pipeline Health
steps.description: ANTON analyses pipeline composition, velocity, coverage ratio, and deal-level risk.

config.promptTemplate:
Analyse the {{review_period}} sales pipeline for forecast target {{forecast_target}}.

Pipeline data:
{{pipeline_data}}

Produce: pipeline coverage analysis, weighted forecast, deals at risk, deals to accelerate, and overall forecast confidence (high/medium/low) with supporting rationale.

steps.label: Competitive Intelligence on Key Deals
steps.description: ANTON produces competitive intelligence on the competitors appearing in the pipeline.

steps.label: Sales Manager Review
steps.description: Review analysis and add deal-specific context and overrides.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the pipeline analysis and competitive intelligence. Flag any deal-specific context, forecast overrides, or corrections.

inputFields.label: Forecast overrides or deal notes
inputFields.placeholder: Any deals where you want to override the analysis, add context, or provide deal-specific intelligence...

inputFields.label: Committed forecast for period
inputFields.placeholder: Your committed forecast number for the period

steps.label: Generate Final Forecast Report
steps.description: ANTON produces the final forecast report incorporating your overrides.
